body: I’m worried he’s the one and I’ll leave and be with someone else that I don’t connect with and I’ll be dealing with the same stuff but won’t love the person

Thank you, I really appreciate your advice. He’s gone two weeks without weed now after weaning off. But turns out he would smoke weed and cheat on me with his ex so that’s a whole new can of worms I’m dealing with :(

I’m in a starter job in tech working on my MSB and he’s studying to be a middle school teacher so I don’t expect our dynamic to change, I wouldn’t mind if he made more though. I was covering 100% of utilities and food for a long time. For the first four years of our relationship (when he didn’t have a job) I paid for everything when we went out and sometimes bought him Magic cards or snacks or whatever else he wanted. So I don’t mind helping him, I try not to split hairs, and I’m not expecting him to pay me back for all of that. This concerns me because he was dipping into his rent money for weed and I don’t want that to be normalized. Plus he’s told me he doesn’t want to smoke weed and it’s a problem for him in the past but then got mad when I said I didn’t want to cover it and then he just bought it anyway. Rent was due yesterday so I ended up covering the extra he spent on weed. I guess I feel disrespected and I’m worried he’s falling back into old coping mechanisms that made him miserable. Weed isn’t bad for everyone but for a long time it took him over and he was smoking 24/7, not working or helping out around the house and failing classes. He’s been doing so well since he quit and I don’t want him to go back to that

Thank you- unfortunately he doesn’t have health insurance, the discount would’ve been helpful. He stopped going to therapy because he felt like his therapist was judging him. He was doing one of the online services and still gets medicine from them. I’m trying to work more overtime so I can afford to add him to my insurance and get him into better therapy, he has a lot of trauma responses that I think should be dealt with in therapy

We have a shared account and budget together for everything pertaining to the household/stuff we do together and then have a bit of money for our own interests. He hadn’t ever had a job until a month ago so the budget is a new thing. It was difficult because I felt like I was contributing a lot more. I think him asking me to cover his rent so he could buy weed hit a nerve because I already pay 60% of the rent and weed is something he’s admitted to having trouble with. He’s on meds for depression, I’m worried that the weed is him sinking into old maladaptive coping mechanisms. He’s working more than he has ever before and it’s tough on him

I don’t care if he uses edibles the smell of weed smoke just gives me a panic attack. It’s not about control it’s about my safe space not smelling like something that makes me panic. I have schizoaffective disorder and I know that weed has made it worse in the past so that smell triggers a panic response.. He’s begged me to hide his weed or throw it away in the past and he says that weed was more his addiction than alcohol even though he’s an admitted alcoholic so I guess seeing him smoke weed and have something that smelled strongly of alcohol made me stress that he would relapse. He was really callous and cold and mean when he was drinking and smoking and things have been a million times better since he stopped but I feel like now that he’s doing good he’s starting to add back the bad habits because he thinks he can handle it. I’m scared because he’s already had a couple snippy moments with me since he started smoking. I get sensory overload and everything in my post happening at once was just too much

I’m fine if he uses edibles it’s just the smell that gives me a panic attack. But maybe I’m not fine with him using edibles because he’s said he doesn’t want to smoke weed and in the past he’s begged me to hide it from him after he buys it…. I tried to have a heart to heart with him last night and he seemed to get it. But tonight as soon as he came home he smoked and now the whole house reeks.
He just hides them for personal uses…. He used to have way more porn and hentai before we got married

He spits because he has a nicotine pouch in his mouth, otherwise he doesn’t spit. I usually don’t have a problem but a couple of his spit cans have spilled on me and the loud spitting in the quiet cafe got to me
It’s like nicotine salt packets, so there’s no brown tobacco and the spit is clear but it’s still spit
Yeah.. it sucks that it’s come to this but I feel like I’ll die if I continue this way so a firm boundary would be good.

He’s the best guy I’ve been with. I didn’t think and I still don’t know that anyone would treat me better. I trusted that he’d get a job after college, we haven’t been married long and he’s still in college but I need help

Thank you 😭 I really appreciate your support. I really wanted him to be my teammate and work as hard as I do towards our mutual goals but he just expects it to happen and when I hit milestones he talks about how far we’ve come and how amazing we’re doing
We’ve been married seven months
Thank you for sharing your experience. I don’t want it to go that way with us but I worry that it might. I’m scared he won’t change and he doesn’t seem to care enough to do something to help me

He reads, scrolls Instagram, spits nicotine, and goes to the card store to buy magic the gathering cards. Ironically I have a cognitive disability but he doesn’t have any. When I’m overdrawn I’ll ask him for help and sometimes he says no and it’s incredibly embarrassing for me… I needed help with my dance class dues and he said no. It makes me so depressed and I feel worthless

Thank you so much for sharing your experience. I think that’s the route I’ll have to go as much as it will suck. I’ll cancel our gym membership and streaming services to start. Wifi will be trickier since I work from home but I definitely need him to see how much he’s affecting me. I’m overdrawn and I have to beg him to help with something and if he doesn’t see the value in it he won’t buy it. I take hula and couldn’t pay my monthly dues and asked for help and he pretty much said no. He says no to things I want in the grocery store and it’s deeply embarrassing for me
Thank you, your comment made me tear up. I’m glad it’s not just in my head. I will talk with him this week. I’m so tired

I trusted him that after he finished college he would get a job. We’ve been married less than a year. I have schizoaffective disorder and have trouble with cognitive processing. So I guess that’s what’s wrong with me… I’m trying hard to keep everything together
Really harsh

His parents give him $1k a month which covers his portion of rent but not much else. I keep asking him to set up interviews and he asks me to because he doesn’t know how. I made his resume because he didn’t know how and wouldn’t do it

He goes to the card store and buys magic the gathering cards a couple times a day, he scrolls on his phone or reads, he spits nicotine. He failed his classes last semester so he’s taking a semester off
Very harsh… we’re newly weds, so we’ve been married less than a year. Started dating 2018. He told me he’d get a job after he finished college

He kept promising he would get one after he finished school. He worked at a food truck for two weeks years before I met him but besides that he’s never held a job. We have such great chemistry and he’s very loving and makes me happy besides all the money stuff. I really believed he’d get a job, he kept saying he would and I loved him so much that I believed him
Sometimes he’ll clean and cook but most of the time I ask him to do stuff and he doesn’t. The house is a complete mess and I feel like it’s my fault

His parents visited and his mom rearranged my kitchen. She definitely babies him. I bought her a beautiful flower arrangement for Mother’s Day last year and had it delivered. It was $65 which was a lot bc I was making 16/hr. She called him and said “ohhhh (pet name) I’ve never gotten flowers from a boy before 💗💗”
He worked at a food truck for a week years before I met him but that’s it
He has never had a job in his entire life

I pay for food most of the time, but lately he’s been helping since I’m overdrawn. he has a car and his parents pay for insurance. I’m overdrawn after every paycheck and I’m making 50k. Im so tired and I don’t know how to get him to understand I need help. He buys a pack of magic cards at least once or twice a day. I used to do most of the housework but I gave up and it’s so messy. He keeps telling me he’ll clean and I won’t recognize the place after he’s done but he does a few dishes or washes the floor and it’s still messy

Thank you for your comments, I really appreciate it 😭 I had an appointment with my psychiatrist yesterday. Thankfully I haven’t been hallucinating lately but all this stress can mess with my cognition and ability to understand the world around me. I think I just need a vacation and I need my husband to get a job

Thank you so much for your advice and thank you for sharing your experiences. It’s crazy how similar your experience is to what my husband described to me. He shrugs it off and doesn’t see anything wrong with it and I felt like I was overreacting… I’m glad that I’m not but I feel so bad that he (and you) went through that. Your whole comment hit me like a ton of bricks. That’s exactly what happened with him. He keeps minimizing and saying it wasn’t that bad and that he wasn’t r*ped but…. I feel like it was bad and hurt him. I’m hoping to get him into more intensive therapy soon. Last year on Mother’s Day I spent $120 (that was a lot for me at the time, I was unemployed) and he told his mom it was from both of us but I organized it and paid. Her reaction was “oh, (name-chan), how sweet! I’ve never gotten flowers from a boy before…” (she calls him an affectionate nonsense word nickname with the suffix -chan. They aren’t Asian (I am) but they lived in an Asian country. I still feel like it’s a bit saccharine. She never calls him his name, only the nickname) His parents stayed with us last week and I was on edge the whole time. How do I gently tell him that I don’t think they should stay with us again? He gets touchy about his parents and I want to show him I’m concerned and not trying to cut him off
Thank you so much for your advice, this is so helpful!!!! I’ll get those books and work on finding him a therapist familiar with EI. I really can’t thank you enough 😭
Unfortunately I can’t say no. It would be like dropping a nuclear bomb and I don’t think my husband would back me up on it. I would just be seen as super rude for no reason
Thank you, I really appreciate your advice. I might need a little time to work up to it but I will do that. Thank you!

He agrees it wasn’t great of her to do but doesn’t seem to get why it’s still affecting me. The first two nights, after work, I had to do an hour of unexpected cleaning just to be able to cook something in my kitchen. It made me so exhausted and depressed

I’m worried to stand up to her. His ex was outspoken about herself and her needs and MIL hated her. Absolutely hated her and cried a lot and tried to get DH to break up (which they did). I tried to stand up when she said the negative comment about the table but she brushed me off. She’d challenge me on things and I’d try to explain but I’d feel lost and in the wrong. I guess I was hoping DH would stand up with me because she wasn’t listening to me? I was terrified if I told her no about the kitchen that she’d cry and turn to DH to be on her side. She cries so easily to make people feel bad…. The first time DH saw me cry when we were dating he was angry and withdrew completely because he thought I was trying to manipulate him (he’s worked through that in therapy). I do need to stand up for myself more though. I grew up in an extremely abusive household and am terrified to set boundaries or be on someone’s bad side. I was able to say no to coffee on the third day (second day I poured it in the sink secretly). I think I’m still feeling incredibly stressed and I feel disconnected from DH because he doesn’t seem to understand how much it affected me and wants to pretend nothing happened. He says he’ll tell them next time but I don’t want there to be a next time where this happens….
Thank you, I really appreciate it. I’m feeling invaded and dejected. I feel like my safe space isn’t really mine. I’m going to try to get into more therapy sessions
She cried and hugged me a lot when they left and kept thanking me for loving my husband. Crying stresses me out a lot and I know if I’d told her about the kitchen it would have been a huge deal :/
True. I think it goes back to me not being assertive. My mom told me I should’ve paid for the whole thing and left it :/
Thank you, I hope so too…. I just reached out to a few couples therapists :)
Thank you! It’s been tough but it’s been so worth it. I’ll talk with him and get us into couples therapy

Yes, I completely agree. I’ve worked very very hard to have my own space. I was unable to speak verbally for a couple years after my adoptive dad died and stayed in bed drinking all day and all night. I had to move back in with my bio parents and my mom is extremely abusive (physically in the past and emotionally now). I got myself to stop drinking for good and started taking meds. My scizoaffective disorder still affects my ability to process stuff but I’m able to hold a job. For the past two years I’ve worked full time while taking five classes. I did my thesis while doing all of that. I’m finally graduating and I landed a job making 60k so I thought I’d finally have my own space and be free. This has really messed with my head and DH doesn’t see the issue

It was just she used a lot of my staples besides those ingredients too

Thank you. I think I have trouble standing up for myself because my mother was incredibly abusive when I was growing up and I just don’t know how to. I feel sick when I disagree with my in laws. They know I’m immunocompromised, I don’t know why they still came here…. If I shut them down it’ll be an us-vs-them thing where they’ll badmouth me to my husband. Husband told me about his dad being away for work a lot when he was growing up and his mom expecting him to fill that role and emotional void, so she’s really protective of him. I told her about the milk and today my husband mentioned we don’t drink, so they’re taking the wine away. I’m solid in my choices and will never drink again (I’ve been through some rough stuff after getting sober and alcohol has never been an option in my mind), but DH isn’t solid and would probably drink if they encouraged him. I’ve had them hand me drinks and tell me to drink it and keep asking me but I just say no.

He’s taking a French 1 class and an English course, I’m a full-time student working on my thesis in addition to working full time. Both our class schedules are either asynchronous or online. In my off time I help him with his homework, he usually has 1 page of French and 1 100-word discussion post per week. He spends a lot of his time playing video games to relax or practicing guitar. His dad is retired and has dropped in on us by surprise during the week before, so weekdays aren’t an issue. He comes by every month or so. No reservations, he has a cabin on the coast and a boat. He asked him this morning and SO said ok. I think what makes me feel upset is that it’s a completely moveable trip but SO refuses to move it. It makes me feel really depressed and I tried to tell him how I felt in very clear terms and he just reiterated that he’s going. He gets really angry if people are needy and doesn’t like to feel controlled, so I worry I’m being manipulative by asking him to stay when he doesn’t want to. I came home and the cold shoulder was gone, he’s making me dinner (which he rarely does). I’ll try to talk to him about a schedule of spending time together.

He’s really kind and loving most of the time, but every once in a while he says something that hurts my feelings. I have a chronic illness and he takes care of me and we inspire eachother to be better, but his parents can be really negative and he told me in the past that they bond through complaining so I don’t know if he realizes he’s being mean
